objective: Catch the audited contract drift with executable negative cases instead of heading/source-string assertions.
acceptanceCriteria:
Missing script/skill, unknown parameter, invalid retry edge, incomplete preflight and invalid concrete example each fail for the intended reason.
Every real workflow is checked against the bundled Cezar contract on Windows/Linux.
The harness never invokes deployment/lifecycle scripts or makes network changes as part of contract inspection.
Unsupported syntax cannot silently pass and production workflows gain no new Node requirement.
nonGoals: No Cezar engine modifications, new production parser, general shell interpreter or broad prose linter.
risks: risk:medium: Use yaml parsing plus the bundled Cezar workflowFileSchema/normalization/stepsIssue through a test-only Node adapter; reuse existing yaml/zod dependencies and pin setup through cezar's lockfile. Do not copy the schema or import the full runtime dependency graph unnecessarily. For Factory pwsh commands, extract -File and script parameters using PowerShell AST/metadata. Validate script existence, declared parameters/common switches and preflight coverage without executing scripts. Explicitly identify command forms the checker supports and fail with actionable diagnostics for unsupported Factory command syntax; shell wrappers are not silently treated as verified. Associate concrete skill JSON examples with result schemas and validate them. Ownership guidance checks get small curated negative examples; do not claim arbitrary prose reasoning is fully machine-verifiable. Wire checks into the normal Windows/Linux CI test gate; add Node setup/test-only dependency install without making deployed PowerShell workflows require Node.
suggestedWorkBreakdown:
Create a minimal test adapter around Cezar's schema functions and parse every Factory workflow, including maintenance/environment/upgrade.
Add PS AST command/preflight checks and skill-example/schema validation.
Add one deliberately broken fixture per contract class, asserting diagnostic file/step/parameter.
Remove redundant weak assertions only after replacement coverage; document local/CI prerequisites.
